structure Stable (H : S.RealSpin) (a : (Bel C.book).RealSpin) (W : DiffPlan S) (V : DiffPlan (Bel C.book))

  units d : ∀ᶠ k in atTop,X.U k d ((Bel C.book).unit d)=S.unit d
